definitions.explanation: A hearty miso soup made with pork and root vegetables such as daikon, carrots, burdock root, and taro. A popular comfort food, especially in autumn and winter.

examples.english: Pork miso soup is delicious on cold days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧{豚汁|とんじる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made pork miso soup with plenty of daikon and carrots.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{豚汁|とんじる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}われた→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧。
examples.english: Pork miso soup was served at the festival food stalls.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
{豚汁|とんじる} has two accepted readings: とんじる (more common in eastern Japan) and ぶたじる (more common in western Japan). Both are widely understood.

USAGE:
{豚汁|とんじる} is a staple of home cooking and is often served at community events, festivals, and school lunches. It is heartier than regular ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧ due to the pork and abundance of root vegetables. It is sometimes described as a meal in itself when paired with rice.
